snippet.title: Camino Portuguese Litoral & Coastal Route: Viana do Castelo to Baiona
snippet.description:
We're walking the Camino Portuguese Litoral, Coastal, and Spiritual Variant routes from Porto to Santiago de Compostela. In this video, we walk from Viano do Castelo, Portugal to Caminhas. Then cross the border by boat to Galicia. From there, it's a stunning coastal walk through iconic towns such as A Guarda, Oia, and finally Baiona. 

We started our walk on March 12, 2026 in Porto, Portugal, and walked the ~290 km route in 16 days.
